text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Dober~ We're not finished yet, you know~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-I'm fine...! I already have plenty...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmhuhu~... The answer is no. Here we 
goooo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I told you, you've asked a million times 
already~! And one hug would've been 
plenty...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No! My rule is that you get as many hugs 
as your age on your birthday, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Geez, as if you don't hug me even when 
it's not my birthday.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
She even crawled right into my bed this 
morning... When I opened my eyes, Taiki's 
face was right in front of me! It scared 
the life out of me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, did you not like it, *yes*? It was so 
cozy and sleepy-sleepy, *no*~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, well... It really was warm enough to 
make me want to fall right back asleep, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Well then, let's do this everyday!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No, just a birthday is more than enough!
